title: form_token bearer capability token stored (and looked up) in plaintext — no hashing at rest
evidence:
form_token        TEXT,                              -- referee form link (~288-bit; internal-only, §4.2)
...and the lookup query in server/src/reference_checks/sql/get_reference_call_by_form_token.sql:
FROM reference_call
WHERE form_token = $1;
detail: The referee form capability token is stored raw and matched by direct equality, so any future DB read (leak, backup, overly broad access) exposes live form links to referee PII. Compensating controls exist (claimed ~288-bit entropy, service_role-only access, RLS deny-all verified), but token issuance lands next (RC3.x) — now is the cheap time to hash.
recommended_fix: Store a keyed digest (e.g. HMAC-SHA-256 or SHA-256) of the token in form_token; hash before lookup in get_reference_call_by_form_token. Keep raw token only in the emailed link.
